SELECT s.context_id, s.inbox_ref, s.archive_root_ref, s.context_root_ref, s.allowed_mime_types, s.max_file_size_mb, s.todo_list_name,
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key', r.category_key, 'label', r.label_de, 'ordner', r.folder_name, 'schema', r.scheme, 'entschieden', r.gliederung_entschieden) ORDER BY r.sort_order, r.category_key)
     FROM jarvis_privat.filing_rule r WHERE r.active) AS regeln,
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kat', t.category_key, 'key', t.sub_key, 'label', t.label_de, 'ordner', t.folder_name) ORDER BY t.sort_order, t.sub_key)
     FROM jarvis_privat.filing_subcategory t WHERE t.active) AS sparten,
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', g.target_id, 'kat', g.category_key, 'sub', g.sub_key, 'anbieter', g.provider_label, 'ordner', g.folder_name,
      'aliases', g.aliases, 'kennungen', g.identifiers, 'person', g.person_key,
      'anzahl', CASE WHEN g.drive_folder_id IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM jarvis_privat.document d WHERE d.status = 'filed' AND d.body->'filing'->>'folder_id' = g.drive_folder_id)
                     WHEN g.sub_key IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM jarvis_privat.document d WHERE d.status = 'filed' AND d.body->'filing'->'anfrage'->>'kategorie_key' = g.category_key AND d.body->'filing'->'anfrage'->>'sparte_key' = g.sub_key) END)
      ORDER BY g.updated_at DESC, g.target_id)
     FROM jarvis_privat.filing_target g WHERE g.active AND g.context_id = 'privat') AS ziele,
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key', f.fall_key, 'label', f.label_de, 'info', f.kurzinfo_de, 'gruppe', f.gruppe, 'tiefe', f.analyse_tiefe,
      'hinweis', f.hinweis_platzhalter, 'pflicht', f.hinweis_pflicht, 'termin_label', f.termin_label, 'termin_standard', f.termin_standard, 'anhang', f.mit_anhang, 'versandform', f.versandform_standard)
      ORDER BY f.sort_order, f.fall_key)
     FROM jarvis_privat.document_fall f WHERE f.active AND f.context_id = 'privat') AS faelle,
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key', v.vorgang_key, 'label', v.label_de, 'erkennung', v.erkennung_de,
      'optionen', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('fall', o.fall_key, 'label', COALESCE(o.label_de, f2.label_de), 'bedingung', o.bedingung_de, 'hinweis', o.hinweis_de, 'gruppe', f2.gruppe) ORDER BY o.sort_order, o.fall_key), '[]'::jsonb)
                   FROM jarvis_privat.vorgang_option o JOIN jarvis_privat.document_fall f2 ON f2.fall_key = o.fall_key AND f2.active
                   WHERE o.vorgang_key = v.vorgang_key AND o.active))
      ORDER BY v.sort_order, v.vorgang_key)
     FROM jarvis_privat.vorgang_typ v WHERE v.active AND v.context_id = 'privat') AS vorgaenge,
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', r.rule_id, 'text', r.regel_de, 'kat', r.geltung_kategorie, 'vorgang', r.geltung_vorgang, 'seit', r.created_at) ORDER BY r.created_at, r.rule_id)
     FROM jarvis_privat.handling_rule r WHERE r.status = 'aktiv' AND r.context_id = 'privat') AS handlungsregeln,
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key', bp.person_key, 'name', bp.anzeigename, 'ordner', bp.ordner_name, 'erkennung', bp.erkennung, 'todo', bp.todo_list_name, 'selbst', bp.ist_selbst) ORDER BY bp.ist_selbst DESC, bp.person_key)
     FROM jarvis_privat.betreute_person bp WHERE bp.aktiv AND bp.context_id = 'privat') AS personen,
  (SELECT m.body FROM jarvis_privat.memory_entry m
     WHERE m.memory_store = 'profile' AND m.entry_type = 'private_address' AND m.status = 'active' AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to > now())
     ORDER BY m.valid_from DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS privatadresse
FROM jarvis_ops.context_document_settings s
WHERE s.context_id = 'privat'

SELECT d.document_id, d.status, d.person_key, d.original_filename, d.received_at, d.category_key, d.body->>'fall' AS fall,
       d.body->'filing'->>'target_path' AS ablage, d.body->'filing'->>'web_link' AS link,
       a.subject_de, a.fristen
FROM jarvis_privat.document d
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT x.subject_de, x.body->'ki'->'fristen' AS fristen
  FROM jarvis_privat.document_analysis x
  WHERE x.document_id = d.document_id
  ORDER BY x.analyzed_at DESC, x.analysis_id DESC LIMIT 1
) a ON true
WHERE d.intake_adapter_id = 'web_desk_s1'
ORDER BY d.received_at DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT d.document_id, d.status, d.original_filename, d.received_at, d.category_key, d.mime_type, d.size_bytes,
       d.source_external_id, d.person_key, d.body->'filing' AS filing, d.body->>'fall' AS fall, a.body AS analyse
FROM jarvis_privat.document d
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT x.body FROM jarvis_privat.document_analysis x
  WHERE x.document_id = d.document_id
  ORDER BY x.analyzed_at DESC, x.analysis_id DESC LIMIT 1
) a ON true
WHERE d.document_id = $1 AND d.intake_adapter_id = 'web_desk_s1'

SELECT d.document_id, d.status, d.original_filename, d.received_at, d.category_key, d.mime_type, d.size_bytes,
       d.source_external_id, d.body->'filing' AS filing, d.body->>'fall' AS fall, a.body AS analyse
FROM jarvis_privat.document d
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT x.body FROM jarvis_privat.document_analysis x
  WHERE x.document_id = d.document_id
  ORDER BY x.analyzed_at DESC, x.analysis_id DESC LIMIT 1
) a ON true
WHERE d.content_hash = $1

SELECT d.document_id, d.status, d.original_filename, d.received_at, d.category_key, d.mime_type, d.size_bytes,
       d.source_external_id, d.person_key, d.body->'filing' AS filing, d.body->>'fall' AS fall, a.body AS analyse
FROM jarvis_privat.document d
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT x.body FROM jarvis_privat.document_analysis x
  WHERE x.document_id = d.document_id
  ORDER BY x.analyzed_at DESC, x.analysis_id DESC LIMIT 1
) a ON true
WHERE d.document_id = $1 AND d.intake_adapter_id = 'web_desk_s1'

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
u AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.document d
  SET status = 'planned',
      body = d.body || jsonb_build_object('filing', COALESCE(d.body->'filing', '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('state', 'running', 'action_id', p.j->>'action_id', 'started_at', now(),
             'prev_status', CASE WHEN d.status = 'planned' THEN COALESCE(d.body->'filing'->>'prev_status', 'understood') ELSE d.status END)),
      updated_at = now()
  FROM p
  WHERE d.document_id = p.j->>'document_id'
    AND (d.status IN ('understood', 'needs_review', 'filed')
         OR (d.status = 'planned' AND (d.body->'filing'->>'state' = 'inconclusive'
             OR (d.body->'filing'->>'state' = 'running' AND (d.body->'filing'->>'started_at')::timestamptz < now() - interval '10 minutes')
             OR (d.body->'filing'->>'state' = 'reverting' AND (d.body->'filing'->>'revert_started_at')::timestamptz < now() - interval '10 minutes'))))
  RETURNING d.document_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u)::int AS gesperrt

parameters.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
upd AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.filing_rule r
  SET scheme = CASE WHEN p.j->>'schema' = 'sparte_jahr' THEN 'sparte_jahr' ELSE r.scheme END, gliederung_entschieden = true
  FROM p
  WHERE r.category_key = p.j->>'kat' AND r.active AND r.scheme = 'jahr' AND NOT r.gliederung_entschieden AND p.j->>'schema' IN ('jahr', 'sparte_jahr')
  RETURNING r.category_key, r.scheme
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.filing_subcategory (category_key, sub_key, label_de, folder_name, sort_order, created_by)
  SELECT p.j->>'kat', v.k, v.l, v.o, v.s, 'rolf_web'
  FROM p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (p.j->>'key', p.j->>'label', p.j->>'ordner', 80), ('sonstige', 'Sonstige', 'Sonstige', 99)) AS v(k, l, o, s)
  WHERE p.j->>'key' IS NOT NULL
    AND (v.s = 80 OR (p.j->>'schema' = 'sparte_jahr' AND p.j->>'key' <> 'sonstige'))
    AND ((p.j->>'schema' IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jarvis_privat.filing_rule r WHERE r.category_key = p.j->>'kat' AND r.scheme IN ('vertrag', 'sparte_jahr') AND r.active))
      OR (p.j->>'schema' = 'sparte_jahr' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upd)))
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING sub_key
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, summary_de, body)
  SELECT 'config_changed', 'rolf',
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upd) THEN 'Gliederung festgelegt: ' || (p.j->>'kat') || ' = ' || (p.j->>'schema') || COALESCE(', Unterkategorie ' || (p.j->>'label'), '')
         ELSE 'Neue Unterkategorie angelegt: ' || (p.j->>'label') END,
    jsonb_build_object('category_key', p.j->>'kat', 'sub_key', p.j->>'key', 'folder_name', p.j->>'ordner', 'scheme', p.j->>'schema', 'neu', (SELECT jsonb_agg(sub_key) FROM ins))
  FROM p
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upd)
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ins WHERE sub_key = (SELECT j->>'key' FROM p))::int AS neu,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM ins)::int AS angelegt,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM upd)::int AS gegliedert,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM l)::int AS protokolliert

SELECT d.document_id, d.status, d.original_filename, d.received_at, d.category_key, d.mime_type, d.size_bytes,
       d.source_external_id, d.body->'filing' AS filing, d.body->>'fall' AS fall, a.body AS analyse
FROM jarvis_privat.document d
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT x.body FROM jarvis_privat.document_analysis x
  WHERE x.document_id = d.document_id
  ORDER BY x.analyzed_at DESC, x.analysis_id DESC LIMIT 1
) a ON true
WHERE d.document_id = $1 AND d.intake_adapter_id = 'web_desk_s1'

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.document (document_id, schema_version, context_id, status, intake_channel, intake_adapter_id, source_external_id,
    original_filename, received_at, source_event_id, mime_type, size_bytes, content_hash, review_required, last_completed_stage, body, created_at, updated_at)
  SELECT j->>'document_id', '1.0.0', 'privat', 'original_secured', 'manual_upload', 'web_desk_s1', j->>'source_external_id',
    j->>'original_filename', (j->>'received_at')::timestamptz, j->>'source_event_id', j->>'mime_type', (j->>'size_bytes')::bigint, j->>'content_hash',
    false, 'intake', j->'body', now(), now()
  FROM p
  ON CONFLICT (content_hash) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING document_id
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, summary_de, body)
  SELECT 'document_received', 'jarvis', 'Dokument über die Weboberfläche eingegangen und im Eingangsordner gesichert',
    jsonb_build_object('document_id', ins.document_id, 'channel', 'manual_upload', 'adapter_id', 'web_desk_s1')
  FROM ins
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT document_id FROM ins) AS document_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM l)::int AS protokolliert

parameters.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
a AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.document_analysis (context_id, document_id, schema_version, analyzed_at, model_role, model_ref, prompt_version,
    subject_de, summary_de, overall_confidence, proposed_task_count, body)
  SELECT 'privat', j->>'document_id', 's1-1.1.0', now(), 'reasoning_model', j->>'model_ref', j->>'prompt_version',
    left(j->>'subject_de', 300), j->>'summary_de', (j->>'confidence')::numeric, (j->>'task_count')::int, j->'analysis'
  FROM p
  RETURNING analysis_id
),
u AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.document d
  SET status = CASE WHEN d.status IN ('filed', 'planned') THEN d.status ELSE p.j->>'status' END,
      document_type_key = NULLIF(p.j->>'document_type_key', ''),
      category_key = CASE WHEN d.status IN ('filed', 'planned') THEN d.category_key ELSE p.j->>'category_key' END,
      review_required = CASE WHEN d.status IN ('filed', 'planned') THEN d.review_required ELSE (p.j->>'review_required')::boolean END,
      review_blocked_stage = CASE WHEN d.status IN ('filed', 'planned') THEN d.review_blocked_stage ELSE NULLIF(p.j->>'review_blocked_stage', '') END,
      last_completed_stage = CASE WHEN d.status IN ('filed', 'planned') THEN d.last_completed_stage ELSE 'analysis' END,
      analysis_ref = (SELECT analysis_id::text FROM a),
      analysis_version = p.j->>'prompt_version',
      page_count = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.j->>'page_count', '')::int, d.page_count),
      body = CASE WHEN p.j->>'fall' IS NOT NULL THEN d.body || jsonb_build_object('fall', p.j->>'fall') ELSE d.body END,
      updated_at = now()
  FROM p
  WHERE d.document_id = p.j->>'document_id'
  RETURNING d.document_id, d.status
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, summary_de, body)
  SELECT CASE WHEN (p.j->>'review_required')::boolean THEN 'review_opened' ELSE 'document_understood' END, 'jarvis', left(p.j->>'log_summary', 500),
    jsonb_build_object('document_id', p.j->>'document_id', 'analysis_id', (SELECT analysis_id FROM a), 'status', p.j->>'status', 'model_ref', p.j->>'model_ref')
  FROM p
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT analysis_id FROM a) AS analysis_id, (SELECT status FROM u) AS status, (SELECT count(*) FROM l)::int AS protokolliert

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
u AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.document d
  SET status = CASE WHEN d.analysis_ref IS NULL AND d.status NOT IN ('filed', 'planned') THEN 'failed' ELSE d.status END,
      review_required = CASE WHEN d.analysis_ref IS NULL AND d.status NOT IN ('filed', 'planned') THEN true ELSE d.review_required END,
      review_blocked_stage = CASE WHEN d.analysis_ref IS NULL AND d.status NOT IN ('filed', 'planned') THEN 'analysis' ELSE d.review_blocked_stage END,
      body = d.body || jsonb_build_object('analysis_error', p.j->'error'), updated_at = now()
  FROM p
  WHERE d.document_id = p.j->>'document_id'
  RETURNING d.document_id
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, summary_de, body)
  SELECT 'review_opened', 'jarvis', left(p.j->>'log_summary', 500), jsonb_build_object('document_id', p.j->>'document_id', 'error', p.j->'error')
  FROM p
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u)::int AS aktualisiert, (SELECT count(*) FROM l)::int AS protokolliert

parameters.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
u AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.document d
  SET status = 'filed', category_key = p.j->>'category_key', person_key = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.j->>'person_key', ''), d.person_key), review_required = false, review_blocked_stage = NULL,
      last_completed_stage = 'filing', body = d.body || jsonb_build_object('filing', p.j->'filing'), updated_at = now()
  FROM p
  WHERE d.document_id = p.j->>'document_id' AND d.status = 'planned'
  RETURNING d.document_id
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, summary_de, body)
  SELECT 'document_filed', COALESCE(p.j->>'actor', 'rolf'), left(p.j->>'log_summary', 500), (p.j->'filing') || jsonb_build_object('document_id', p.j->>'document_id')
  FROM p
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM u)
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u)::int AS aktualisiert, (SELECT count(*) FROM l)::int AS protokolliert

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
u AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.document d
  SET status = CASE WHEN p.j->>'zustand' = 'failed' THEN COALESCE(d.body->'filing'->>'prev_status', 'understood') ELSE d.status END,
      body = d.body || jsonb_build_object('filing', COALESCE(d.body->'filing', '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
               'state', CASE WHEN p.j->>'zustand' = 'failed' AND d.body->'filing'->>'prev_status' = 'filed' THEN 'done' ELSE p.j->>'zustand' END,
               'letzter_fehler', p.j->'error', 'failed_at', now())),
      updated_at = now()
  FROM p
  WHERE d.document_id = p.j->>'document_id' AND d.status = 'planned'
  RETURNING d.document_id, d.status
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, summary_de, body)
  SELECT 'review_opened', 'jarvis', CASE WHEN p.j->>'zustand' = 'failed' THEN 'Ablage fehlgeschlagen' ELSE 'Ablage unklar, Nachweis fehlt' END,
    jsonb_build_object('document_id', p.j->>'document_id', 'action_id', p.j->>'action_id', 'zustand', p.j->>'zustand', 'error', p.j->'error')
  FROM p
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u)::int AS aktualisiert, (SELECT count(*) FROM l)::int AS protokolliert

SELECT d.document_id, d.status, a.body->'ki' AS ki,
  COALESCE(CASE WHEN d.status <> 'filed' THEN a.body->'vorschlag'->>'person_key' END, d.person_key) AS person_key,
  (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('task_id', t.task_id, 'key', t.idempotency_key, 'status', t.status, 'todo', t.body->'todo')), '[]'::jsonb)
     FROM jarvis_privat.task t WHERE t.body->>'document_id' = d.document_id) AS aufgaben
FROM jarvis_privat.document d
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT x.body FROM jarvis_privat.document_analysis x
  WHERE x.document_id = d.document_id
  ORDER BY x.analyzed_at DESC, x.analysis_id DESC LIMIT 1
) a ON true
WHERE d.document_id = $1 AND d.intake_adapter_id = 'web_desk_s1'

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.task (task_id, person_key, schema_version, title, success_criterion, actor, status, priority, due_at, idempotency_key, body)
  SELECT p.j->>'task_id', p.j->>'person_key', '1.0.0', p.j->>'titel', p.j->>'erfolg', 'rolf', 'open', p.j->>'prio', (p.j->>'due_at')::timestamptz, p.j->>'key',
    jsonb_set(p.j->'body', '{todo,since}', to_jsonb(now()))
  FROM p
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING task_id
),
cl AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.task t
  SET due_at = (p.j->>'due_at')::timestamptz, priority = p.j->>'prio',
      body = jsonb_set(t.body || jsonb_build_object('frist', p.j->'body'->'frist', 'frist_quelle', p.j->'body'->'frist_quelle'), '{todo}',
        coalesce(t.body->'todo', '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('state', 'sending', 'since', now(), 'action_id', p.j->'body'->'todo'->'action_id', 'titel', p.j->'body'->'todo'->'titel')),
      updated_at = now()
  FROM p
  WHERE t.idempotency_key = p.j->>'key' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)
    AND (coalesce(t.body->'todo'->>'state', 'neu') IN ('neu', 'failed')
      OR (t.body->'todo'->>'state' = 'sending' AND (t.body->'todo'->>'since')::timestamptz < now() - interval '2 minutes'))
  RETURNING t.task_id
)
SELECT (SELECT task_id FROM ins) AS neu, (SELECT task_id FROM cl) AS erneut

parameters.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
u AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.task t SET body = jsonb_set(t.body, '{todo}', p.j->'todo'), updated_at = now()
  FROM p WHERE t.task_id = p.j->>'task_id' AND t.body->'todo'->>'state' = 'sending'
  RETURNING t.task_id
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, action_id, task_id, summary_de, body)
  SELECT 'task_created', 'rolf', p.j->'todo'->>'action_id', p.j->>'task_id', left(p.j->>'log_summary', 500),
    jsonb_build_object('document_id', p.j->>'document_id', 'todo_list_id', p.j->'todo'->>'list_id', 'todo_task_id', p.j->'todo'->>'task_id', 'frist', p.j->'todo'->>'due')
  FROM p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM u)
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u)::int AS aktualisiert, (SELECT count(*) FROM l)::int AS protokolliert

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
u AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.task t
  SET body = jsonb_set(t.body, '{todo}', coalesce(t.body->'todo', '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('state', 'failed', 'fehler', left(p.j->>'fehler', 300), 'failed_at', now())),
      updated_at = now()
  FROM p WHERE t.task_id = p.j->>'task_id'
  RETURNING t.task_id, t.body->'todo'->>'action_id' AS action_id
),
l AS (

  SELECT 'task_sync_failed', 'jarvis', u.action_id, u.task_id, left('To-Do-Übertragung fehlgeschlagen: ' || (p.j->>'fehler'), 500), jsonb_build_object('fehler', p.j->>'fehler')
  FROM u, p
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u)::int AS markiert, (SELECT count(*) FROM l)::int AS protokolliert

parameters.query:
SELECT task_id, title, status, due_at, body FROM jarvis_privat.task
WHERE body->>'document_id' = $1 AND body->>'quelle' = 'web_desk_s2'
ORDER BY created_at

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
c AS (SELECT x->>'task_id' AS tid, x->>'status' AS st, x->>'todo_status' AS ts FROM p, jsonb_array_elements(p.j->'aenderungen') x),
u AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.task t SET status = c.st, body = jsonb_set(t.body, '{todo,status}', to_jsonb(c.ts)), updated_at = now()
  FROM c WHERE t.task_id = c.tid AND (t.status <> c.st OR coalesce(t.body->'todo'->>'status', '') <> c.ts)
  RETURNING t.task_id, c.st, c.ts
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, task_id, summary_de, body)
  SELECT 'task_status_synced', 'jarvis', u.task_id, 'Aufgabenstatus aus To Do übernommen: ' || u.st, jsonb_build_object('todo_status', u.ts)
  FROM u
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u)::int AS geaendert

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
d AS (
  SELECT dd.document_id, dd.body->'filing'->>'folder_id' AS folder_id
  FROM jarvis_privat.document dd, p
  WHERE p.j ? 'document_id' AND dd.document_id = p.j->>'document_id' AND dd.status = 'filed' AND dd.body->'filing'->>'state' = 'done'
),
v AS (
  SELECT p.j, CASE WHEN p.j->>'schema' = 'vertrag' THEN d.folder_id END AS fid
  FROM p, d
  WHERE p.j->>'schema' <> 'vertrag'
     OR (d.folder_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM jarvis_privat.filing_target x
          WHERE x.drive_folder_id = d.folder_id
            AND NOT (x.person_key = p.j->>'person' AND x.category_key = p.j->>'kat' AND coalesce(x.sub_key, '') = coalesce(p.j->>'sub', '') AND x.provider_key = p.j->>'provider_key')))
),
up AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.filing_target AS t (target_id, person_key, category_key, sub_key, provider_key, provider_label, folder_name, drive_folder_id, aliases, identifiers, created_by)
  SELECT v.j->>'target_id', v.j->>'person', v.j->>'kat', NULLIF(v.j->>'sub', ''), v.j->>'provider_key', v.j->>'label', v.j->>'folder_name', v.fid,
         ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(v.j->'aliases')), ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(v.j->'identifiers')), 'jarvis_ablage'
  FROM v
  WHERE v.j ? 'person'
  ON CONFLICT (context_id, person_key, category_key, coalesce(sub_key, ''), provider_key) DO UPDATE
  SET folder_name = EXCLUDED.folder_name,
      drive_folder_id = EXCLUDED.drive_folder_id,
      aliases = ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT e FROM unnest(t.aliases || EXCLUDED.aliases) AS e),
      identifiers = ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT e FROM unnest(t.identifiers || EXCLUDED.identifiers) AS e),
      active = true,
      updated_at = now()
  RETURNING t.target_id, t.folder_name, (xmax = 0) AS neu
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, summary_de, body)
  SELECT 'config_changed', 'jarvis', CASE WHEN up.neu THEN 'Ablageregister: neues Ziel ' ELSE 'Ablageregister: Ziel bestätigt ' END || up.target_id,
    jsonb_build_object('target_id', up.target_id, 'folder_name', up.folder_name, 'document_id', (SELECT j->>'document_id' FROM p), 'change_request', 'CR-06')
  FROM up
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM up)::int AS fortgeschrieben, (SELECT count(*) FROM l)::int AS protokolliert

WITH u AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.document d
  SET body = d.body || jsonb_build_object('fall', $2::text, 'fall_vorher', COALESCE(d.body->>'fall', 'ablegen'), 'fall_geaendert_at', now()),
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE d.document_id = $1 AND d.intake_adapter_id = 'web_desk_s1' AND COALESCE(d.body->>'fall', 'ablegen') <> $2::text
  RETURNING d.document_id
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, summary_de, body)
  SELECT 'document_case_changed', 'rolf', 'Fall des Dokuments geändert auf ' || $2::text, jsonb_build_object('document_id', u.document_id, 'fall', $2::text)
  FROM u
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u)::int AS geaendert,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM jarvis_privat.document d WHERE d.document_id = $1 AND d.intake_adapter_id = 'web_desk_s1')::int AS vorhanden

SELECT d.document_id, d.status, d.original_filename, d.source_external_id, d.body->'filing' AS filing
FROM jarvis_privat.document d
WHERE d.document_id = $1 AND d.intake_adapter_id = 'web_desk_s1'

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
u AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.document d
  SET status = 'planned',
      body = d.body || jsonb_build_object('filing', (d.body->'filing') || jsonb_build_object('state', 'reverting', 'revert_action_id', p.j->>'action_id', 'revert_started_at', now())),
      updated_at = now()
  FROM p
  WHERE d.document_id = p.j->>'document_id' AND d.body->'filing'->>'action_id' = p.j->>'alt_action_id' AND (d.body->'filing'->>'auto')::boolean IS TRUE
    AND ((d.status = 'filed' AND d.body->'filing'->>'state' = 'done')
      OR (d.status = 'planned' AND d.body->'filing'->>'state' = 'reverting' AND (d.body->'filing'->>'revert_started_at')::timestamptz < now() - interval '10 minutes'))
  RETURNING d.document_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u)::int AS gesperrt

parameters.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
u AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.document d
  SET status = 'understood', last_completed_stage = 'analysis',
      body = d.body || jsonb_build_object('filing', jsonb_build_object('state', 'reverted', 'action_id', p.j->>'action_id', 'reverted_at', now(),
               'vorher', ((d.body->'filing') - 'revert_action_id' - 'revert_started_at') || jsonb_build_object('state', 'done'), 'evidence', p.j->'evidence')),
      updated_at = now()
  FROM p
  WHERE d.document_id = p.j->>'document_id' AND d.status = 'planned' AND d.body->'filing'->>'state' = 'reverting' AND d.body->'filing'->>'revert_action_id' = p.j->>'action_id'
  RETURNING d.document_id
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, summary_de, body)
  SELECT 'document_unfiled', 'rolf', left('Ablage rückgängig gemacht, Datei zurück im Eingang (vorher ' || (p.j->>'alter_pfad') || ')', 500),
    jsonb_build_object('document_id', p.j->>'document_id', 'action_id', p.j->>'action_id', 'evidence', p.j->'evidence')
  FROM p
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM u)
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u)::int AS aktualisiert, (SELECT count(*) FROM l)::int AS protokolliert

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
u AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.document d
  SET status = CASE p.j->>'lage' WHEN 'ziel' THEN 'filed' WHEN 'eingang' THEN 'understood' ELSE 'planned' END,
      last_completed_stage = CASE WHEN p.j->>'lage' = 'eingang' THEN 'analysis' ELSE d.last_completed_stage END,
      body = d.body || jsonb_build_object('filing', CASE p.j->>'lage'
        WHEN 'ziel' THEN ((d.body->'filing') - 'revert_action_id' - 'revert_started_at') || jsonb_build_object('state', 'done', 'revert_fehler', p.j->'error', 'revert_failed_at', now())
        WHEN 'eingang' THEN jsonb_build_object('state', 'reverted', 'action_id', p.j->>'action_id', 'reverted_at', now(),
          'vorher', ((d.body->'filing') - 'revert_action_id' - 'revert_started_at') || jsonb_build_object('state', 'done'), 'evidence', p.j->'evidence')
        ELSE ((d.body->'filing') - 'revert_action_id' - 'revert_started_at') || jsonb_build_object('state', 'inconclusive', 'revert_fehler', p.j->'error', 'revert_failed_at', now())
      END),
      updated_at = now()
  FROM p
  WHERE d.document_id = p.j->>'document_id' AND d.status = 'planned' AND d.body->'filing'->>'state' = 'reverting' AND d.body->'filing'->>'revert_action_id' = p.j->>'action_id'
  RETURNING d.document_id, d.status
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, summary_de, body)
  SELECT CASE WHEN p.j->>'lage' = 'eingang' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM u) THEN 'document_unfiled' ELSE 'review_opened' END,
    CASE WHEN p.j->>'lage' = 'eingang' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM u) THEN 'rolf' ELSE 'jarvis' END,
    left(CASE WHEN p.j->>'lage' = 'eingang' THEN 'Ablage rückgängig gemacht, Datei zurück im Eingang, nach Störung nachgelesen (vorher ' || COALESCE(p.j->>'alter_pfad', '') || ')'
              WHEN p.j->>'lage' = 'ziel' THEN 'Rückgängigmachen fehlgeschlagen, Datei unverändert am Ablageort'
              ELSE 'Rückgängigmachen unklar, Lage der Datei nicht bestätigt' END, 500),
    jsonb_build_object('document_id', p.j->>'document_id', 'action_id', p.j->>'action_id', 'lage', p.j->>'lage', 'error', p.j->'error', 'evidence', p.j->'evidence', 'datensatz', (SELECT count(*) FROM u))
  FROM p
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u)::int AS entsperrt, (SELECT status FROM u) AS status

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
dup AS (
  SELECT r.rule_id FROM jarvis_privat.handling_rule r, p
  WHERE p.j->>'op' = 'neu' AND r.status = 'aktiv' AND lower(btrim(r.regel_de)) = lower(btrim(p.j->>'text'))
    AND r.geltung_kategorie IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(p.j->>'kat', '') AND r.geltung_vorgang IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(p.j->>'vorgang', '')
  LIMIT 1
),
anz AS (SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM jarvis_privat.handling_rule WHERE status = 'aktiv' AND context_id = 'privat'),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.handling_rule (rule_id, regel_de, geltung_kategorie, geltung_vorgang, anlass_document_id, quelle)
  SELECT p.j->>'rule_id', btrim(p.j->>'text'), NULLIF(p.j->>'kat', ''), NULLIF(p.j->>'vorgang', ''), NULLIF(p.j->>'doc', ''), 'web_desk'
  FROM p, anz
  WHERE p.j->>'op' = 'neu' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dup) AND anz.n < 50
  RETURNING rule_id
),
aus AS (
  UPDATE jarvis_privat.handling_rule r SET status = 'inaktiv', deactivated_at = now()
  FROM p
  WHERE p.j->>'op' = 'aus' AND r.rule_id = p.j->>'rule_id' AND r.status = 'aktiv'
  RETURNING r.rule_id, r.regel_de
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action_log (entry_kind, actor, summary_de, body)
  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins) THEN 'rule_created' ELSE 'rule_deactivated' END, 'rolf',
    left(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins) THEN 'Regel angelegt: ' || btrim(p.j->>'text') ELSE 'Regel deaktiviert: ' || COALESCE((SELECT regel_de FROM aus), '') END, 500),
    jsonb_build_object('rule_id', COALESCE((SELECT rule_id FROM ins), (SELECT rule_id FROM aus)), 'quelle', 'web_desk', 'document_id', NULLIF(p.j->>'doc', ''))
  FROM p
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aus)
  RETURNING log_id
)
SELECT (SELECT rule_id FROM ins) AS neu, (SELECT rule_id FROM aus) AS aus, (SELECT rule_id FROM dup) AS dublette,
  (SELECT n FROM anz) AS anzahl, (SELECT count(*) FROM l)::int AS protokolliert
